description: This file defines a generic internal class DurableState<T> that manages persistent state in the Orleans framework, providing mechanisms for applying updates, clearing state, and serialization/deserialization logic as part of durable state management.

classes.name: DurableState<T>
classes.description: An internal sealed class managing durable state for a generic type T, supporting state application, persistence, snapshotting, and versioning within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: DurableState
methods.description: Constructor initializing the durable state with a key, manager, codec, and session pool; registers state machine with the manager.

methods.name: OnWriteCompleted
methods.description: Increments version counter and invokes OnPersisted callback after a successful write.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal value to default state.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry to update the state, deserializing based on command type and managing version.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Appends log entries for state persistence.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: Appends snapshot for durable state snapshotting.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Method intended to create a deep copy of the durable state (not implemented).

methods.name: WriteState
methods.description: Serializes and writes the current state to the storage.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the current state asynchronously (currently a no-op).
